name: Ashdod
overview: Ashdod was a prominent Philistine city, notable for housing the temple of Dagon where the ark of the covenant was temporarily placed after the Philistines captured it. The Scriptures record how the idol Dagon fell before the ark, demonstrating the supremacy of the God of Israel over pagan gods. Ashdod's significance is further underscored by its mention as a dwelling place for the Anakim and as part of the territory assigned to Judah. These events highlight both the spiritual conflict between the true God and false idols and God's sovereign control over nations and cities.
